scripts.serve:all: concurrently -c "#818cf8,#34d399,#fbbf24" -n "student,course,enrollment" "cd services/student-service && php artisan serve --port=8001" "cd services/course-service && php artisan serve --port=8002" "cd services/enrollment-service && php artisan serve --port=8003"
scripts.build:services: concurrently "cd services/student-service && npm run build" "cd services/course-service && npm run build" "cd services/enrollment-service && npm run build"
scripts.install:services: cd services/student-service && npm install && cd ../course-service && npm install && cd ../enrollment-service && npm install
scripts.fresh:services: concurrently "cd services/student-service && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed" "cd services/course-service && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed" "cd services/enrollment-service && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed"
